pattern_matches.text: wine.name must be unique across all wines in the system
wine.selling_price must be strictly greater than wine.cost_price
wine.stock_quantity must be non-negative
wine.primary_storage_location must be assigned to exactly one storage location
storage_location.assigned_bottles_count must not exceed storage_location.max_bottle_capacity
storage_location cannot be deleted if it has assigned bottles
wine.stock_quantity cannot be reduced below zero
storage_location.assigned_bottles_count must be zero when the location is deleted
add_wine: Adds a new wine entry to the inventory with validation for uniqueness and pricing constraints.
assign_bottle_to_location: Assigns a bottle of a specific wine to a storage location, validating capacity and stock constraints.
get_wine_by_name: Retrieves a wine entry by its name, ensuring uniqueness and existence in the system.
get_storage_location_by_id: Retrieves a storage location by its ID, ensuring it exists in the system.
get_total_stock_by_wine_type: Calculates the total stock quantity across all wines of a specified type.
get_total_stock_by_location_zone: Calculates the total stock quantity across all wines stored in a specific zone of a storage location.
validate_pricing: Validates that the selling price is strictly greater than the cost price.
validate_stock_quantity: Ensures the stock quantity does not drop below zero.
validate_location_capacity: Checks if a storage location's current capacity is below its maximum capacity.
handle_invalid_pricing: Raises an exception when the selling price is not strictly greater than the cost price.
handle_negative_stock: Raises an exception when stock quantity is negative.
handle_location_over_capacity: Raises an exception when a location exceeds its maximum bottle capacity.
handle_wine_name_duplicate: Raises an exception when a wine name already exists in the system.
handle_location_in_use: Raises an exception when attempting to remove a location with assigned bottles.
